en.h1: Questions we can answer from published pages
en.intro: Short answers to common questions, each tied to a published KRIOS page and a named source. The Guide never answers from drafts. If a question is not sourced well enough yet, it says so and points you to the published film instead.
en.ask_label: Ask about Greece, the films or KRIOS
en.ask_ph: For example: When is the feast of Saint Demetrios?
en.ask_note: Answers come only from KRIOS's published films and articles. Your question stays on this device. Please do not enter personal information.
en.nc_h: KRIOS has not covered that yet
en.nc_p: The Guide only answers from published KRIOS pages. Try the questions below, or browse the films.
en.only_en: This answer is available in English.
en.sg_what: Only your question, the page language and today's date will be sent. No name, address or device details.
en.sg_off: Topic suggestions open when the Guide launches.
en.sg_sent: Thank you. Your topic was sent to KRIOS.
en.sg_fail: The suggestion could not be sent. Please try again later.
en.draft: Draft translation for review. Not yet approved.
en.privacy: Nothing you open or type here is saved or sent anywhere, unless you choose to suggest a topic. The Guide uses no tracking.
